## External Sources

Bring cited research from trusted legal sources, web search and LexisNexis Protégé into the contract workflow.

## New Lumi

Access Contract Intelligence via a single conversational starting point to find information, build a plan and take action across connected workflows.

[GET EARLY ACCESS](https://www.luminance.com/resources/forward-october-2026#get-started)

IN BETA

## Lumi MCP

Extend Contract Intelligence into the tools teams already use, including Slack, ChatGPT, Outlook and more.

[GET EARLY ACCESS](https://www.luminance.com/resources/forward-october-2026#get-started)

## Parallel Approvals

Move contracts through independent reviews simultaneously, giving each team clear visibility while keeping execution aligned with Legal-defined rules.

[JOIN THE WAITLIST](https://www.luminance.com/resources/forward-october-2026#get-started)

COMING SOON

## NDA Negotiation Agent

Empower teams across the business to move routine contract negotiations forward automatically, with Legal-approved guardrails.

[JOIN THE WAITLIST](https://www.luminance.com/resources/forward-october-2026#get-started)

COMING SOON

## Obligation Tracking

Proactively surface renewals, cancellation windows, recurring spend and non-standard terms so teams can act before issues arise.

## Scheduled Reports

Turn contract insights into recurring, actionable reports that keep teams and leadership informed about upcoming obligations and decisions.

## Template Agent

Turn gold standard contracts into reusable templates that help the wider business create the right document faster.

[GET IN TOUCH](https://www.luminance.com/resources/forward-october-2026#get-started)

IN BETA

## Playbook Supervisor

Make Legal negotiation knowledge reusable by converting playbooks into structured, reviewable guidance for incoming contracts — all via natural language conversation.

[GET EARLY ACCESS](https://www.luminance.com/resources/forward-october-2026#get-started)

**Deep dive into Luminance’s latest innovations designed to help your teams:**

- Create reusable templates and playbooks from legal expertise.


- Access Contract Intelligence through a single conversational experience.


- Add trusted research into your contract workflows.


- Bring Luminance into the tools teams already use.


- Automate routine work within Legal-approved guardrails.
